CALL FOR RESEARCH POSTERS
GeniSys 2027
Exploring Synergy among Next-Generation AI, Systems, and Networking for a Sustainable Future

Rice University | Houston, Texas
Venue: Ralph S. O’Connor Building for Engineering and Science
Room: Fifth-floor conference room
Schedule: https://yukewang96.github.io/GeniSys27/schedule.html
Event timing: Spring 2027
Exact event date: To be announced
Submission deadline: To be announced
Submission channel: Box upload
Box upload link: https://rice.app.box.com/f/0370111606fc4a1da368d135b485fb80

GeniSys 2027 invites research posters exploring the intersection of artificial intelligence, computing systems, and networking. We welcome recent research and previously published work. The poster session offers an opportunity to share results, exchange ideas, and connect with researchers, practitioners, and students across these communities.

TOPICS OF INTEREST
Topics include, but are not limited to:
- Scalable AI training and efficient distributed inference
- GPU and heterogeneous system optimization
- Communication-efficient learning and networking for AI
- Reliable and resilient AI infrastructure
- Energy-efficient and sustainable computing
- Secure AI deployment and cross-layer co-design

ELIGIBLE WORK
Both recent research and previously published work are welcome. Presenters are encouraged to explain the research problem, approach, and key results or insights, and to highlight questions for discussion with the workshop community.

WORKSHOP EXPERIENCE
The tentative one-day program includes a keynote, invited talks, a lunch poster/demo session, a panel, student lightning talks, and a research roundtable. Hybrid participation is planned; arrangements for remote poster presentations will be announced.

SUBMISSION INFORMATION
Upload your research poster to Box: https://rice.app.box.com/f/0370111606fc4a1da368d135b485fb80

Recent research and previously published work are both welcome.

The submission deadline, file requirements, and poster dimensions will be announced. Follow the instructions on the Box upload page and check the workshop website for updates.

ORGANIZERS
T. S. Eugene Ng, Professor, Computer Science, Rice University
Yuke Wang, Assistant Professor, Computer Science, Rice University
Jiarong Xing, Assistant Professor, Computer Science, Rice University

The workshop program is tentative and subject to change.
